author: Prarthana Ghosh
text: I had an excellent dental treatment experience with Dr. Sukhwant Yadav at The Dental Home. The entire procedure was handled with great care and extremely professional. Highly recommend The Dental Home for your dental treatment.

author: Varun Kukreja
text: I have received comprehensive guidance and RCT treatment from Dr. Sukhwant from Dental Home. In my opinion, Doctor Sukhwant is very experienced and knowledgeable. He has a helpful and friendly nature.

author: Robin C. Thomas
text: Dr Sukhwant is very patient and good with kids. I took my autistic 5 yr old son to him, he was able to engage him and treat one of the fillings gently. My kid was initially afraid, but Dr. Sukhwant handled him with immense patience and care.

author: Preeti Goyal
text: Very sweet and humble doctor with a great experience. The clinic maintains the highest hygiene standards and provides truly gentle, personalized care.

author: Dr. Kusum Jasuja
text: Highly appreciate and recommend Dr. Sukhwant in Chittaranjan Park, New Delhi for any kind of dental treatment - surgical or medical. His vast experience during MDS Endodontics at AIIMS Delhi and afterwards comes as a blessing for his patients. My dental treatment was completely painless and symptom-free afterwards too. Thank you!

author: Soham Perret
text: I had a great experience with Dr. Sukhwant who is highly professional and caring! I visited his clinic for my root canal treatment and he made me feel very comfortable and explained everything very clearly. I am very much satisfied with the quality of his treatment and would definitely recommend this clinic for anyone looking for RCT in Delhi.

author: Shweta Kashyap
text: Their services are absolutely top-notch! Dr. Sukhwant is super attentive and really cares about their patients. I felt completely looked after, and the whole experience was so smooth and professional.

author: Jaspreet Kaur
text: Visits to dentists have been super scary for me in the past. But unlike others, my visit to Dr. Sukhwant sir has been super relaxing. He is an empathetic doctor. He makes one feel relaxed right from the consultation to the post treatment care. He is my trustworthy, go-to dentist now!

author: Mohana Talapatra
text: I cannot recommend Dr Yadav highly enough! I had no idea that a dental experience could be so reassuring, pain-free and the procedure done so expertly and with utmost confidence, as at Dr Yadav's clinic. The doctor will not advise any unnecessary procedures and add-ons. If you need an RCT, please do yourselves a favor and do not look anywhere else but to Dr Yadav for the most pain-free and reassuring treatment! Thank you, Dr Yadav - a fan for life!

author: Saurabh Pangariya
text: My father got his dental treatment done here. My father is very happy with the help, support, and understanding shown by Dr. Sukhwant Ji. Dr. Sukhwant explains all the options for the treatment, durability, and costs involved, and performs the treatment himself with total dedication. That's all we as patients could ask for. Thank you Dr. Sukhwant Ji!

author: Sulagno Basu
text: I had an extraction done at Dr. Sukhwant Yadav's dental clinic. I found the services to be excellent and the procedure was performed seamlessly with utmost care and precaution. The clinic is well-equipped and the staff was very supportive. I would highly recommend Dr. Yadav for any dental issues.
